description_en: Deletes a member of the resource account type
description_zh: 调用DeleteAccount删除资源类型的成员
name: DeleteAccount

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the member that you want to delete
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the check items that you can choose to ignore for the member deletion.

You can obtain the IDs from the response of the [GetAccountDeletionCheckResult](~~GetAccountDeletionCheckResult~~) operation
parameters.help_zh:
可以选择放弃并继续执行成员删除的检查项ID。

该ID从[GetAccountDeletionCheckResult](~~GetAccountDeletionCheckResult~~)的返回参数AbandonableChecks中获取
parameters.name: abandonable_check_id
